tool_input.description: Start interactive rebase from the last clean commit
Reset to fold commit to recover
Clear staging and reset to fold commit
Stash changes and reset to fold commit

tool_input.command:
cd "/home/author/Documents/GitHub/repo\.campaign\sandbox\w2\git.history_rewrite-v5-17874792022425" && cat > /tmp/rebase-script.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# First commit (3898ae8) becomes pick, rest become squash
if [[ "$1" == *"3898ae8"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"fe62734"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"94fb8be"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"fdacdf2"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"5be6ce3"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"0069414"* ]] || [[ "$1" == *"698b0fa"* ]]; then
  sed -i '1s/^pick /squash /' "$1"
fi
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/rebase-script.sh
git rebase -i 2290dfd -x "sed -i '2,8s/^pick /squash /' \$GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR" 2>&1 | head -20
